authorization: 认同你的观点。请你重新设定研究目标，并自主研究
objective: 检验只做多条件下扣费后机会数量、盈利余量与可识别性；有依据才构建原硬门达标且标准扰动能力更强的完整策略。
scope: 仅S013既有510500.SH，2020-01-02至2026-09-30和原预热；1m资本，HFQ原锚点，固定1%LimitBuyHold，每侧10bp，不跨族/外部/封存/DEV/PTE/生产。
frequency: 全池平均每60session>=4，1636session至少110闭合；不要求每个下跌年份单独达标。
negative_buyhold_years: 实际基准亏损年份净收益严格>0；未改为>=0。
label: nextOpen to nextOpen+h, fee proxy=(exit/entry)*.999/1.001-1; actual native limit/lot/fill model not simulated
horizon_reason: bear.TIME4/bull.TIME8 matches actual age-zero entry; h10 links original stage2; h1 tests only short-lived EX061 reverse clue. No horizon optimization.

components.early_reclaim_weakness: negative of EX061 volume-weighted early-close reclaim

hypothesis: 暂时卖压后的回归在下一开盘之后提供旧BODY、位置、量能、ACF和确认之外的扣费后收益；正值方向预声明，风险不预设改善。
selection_history: 反方向来自已见EX061，期限来自已见C8880，均非独立新样本。符号反转不会创造新信息；重复h1仅检查扣费水平，不称独立确认。

label_contract.return_h: Open[T+1+h]/Open[T+1]*(1-.001)/(1+.001)-1; fractional open-fill fee proxy; h complete sessions held
label_contract.negative_gap_next: Not tested: next open gap is already realized before proposed entry
label_contract.maturity_columns: label_end_<label>; first test signal strictly after train label maturity

statistics.correlation: Spearman average ties; partial rank IC uses OLS residuals with intercept and all fourteen controls; residual norm <=1e-10 of original centered-rank norm is explained/unavailable
statistics.non_overlap: h+1 phases fixed by original full signal index positions before finite/opportunity filtering

bootstrap.sampling: overlapping full-time-axis blocks, uniform starts, truncate to original length; filter opportunity after sampling
bootstrap.interval: 2.5/97.5% linear quantiles; at least 400 valid replicates
bootstrap.scope: full-pool and opportunity-pool only; descriptive, no search-selection correction

walk_forward.train: 2020 <= signal year < test year AND label_end_label < first actual test-year signaldate
walk_forward.groups: train feature Q25/Q75 linear; test low <= Q25, high >= Q75; original label means
walk_forward.ridge: rank features via train empirical CDF midpoint ties; original target; intercept unpenalized; alpha=10
walk_forward.common_model_rows: all 16 feature columns finite, target finite, training target mature; identical model rows
walk_forward.baseline: training target mean on identical training rows; compare test MSE and Spearman IC

statistics.scope: all rows and optional original strategy ex-ante eligibility; no profitable-row selection
limitations: Already-seen development pool; chronological pseudo-out-of-sample, not sealed independent validation.
No hyperparameter search; all labels, years, phases, components and failures retained.
Future labels never enter feature columns, ECDF, thresholds, or fitting before maturity.
Intervals are descriptive diagnostics and do not correct development-pool selection bias.

declining_definition: 信号当日过去20日momentum<0，因果固定分层，不等同全年buyhold亏损或原raw路线；年份仅事后诊断。
capacity: Future-aware interval-DP over fixed1/4/8/10 horizons, fractional full-capital open fills with10bp each side, one-session turnaround; fullpool best growth constrained>=110. Yearly capacity not yearly hardgate. Not tradable; no limit/tick/lot restrictions.
oracle_non_claims: Cannot prove live strategy feasibility or universal impossibility. No oracle prices used in predictors. Native-account original frequency/annual continuous equity unchanged.
stop_policy: 若无稳定控制后增量，停止两条固定反向表达的策略化；不扫阈值或再翻方向；正负结果及薄组全保留。下一新信息假说须另行事前留证。
limits: 已反复研究开发池，时间顺序测试非封存；成本代理非账户收益，重叠标签非组合，未知历史发布时间、供应商修订未独立验证。
